Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". ---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: topic-service-bootstrap
  namespace: flux-system
  labels:
    ic-ops.com/phase: bootstrap
  annotations:
    event.toolkit.fluxcd.io/app: topic-service
    event.toolkit.fluxcd.io/phase: bootstrap
    event.toolkit.fluxcd.io/overlay_tag: git-4570dcb
spec:
  interval: 1h
  timeout: 1m
  prune: true # prune removes objects that no longer exist in the supplied manifests, so nothing gets orphaned
  sourceRef:
    kind: OCIRepository
    name: topic-service-bootstrap
  healthChecks:
    # New benefit, making sure the bootstrap has initalized resources properly
    - apiVersion: v1

  name: topic-service-init
  namespace: flux-system
  labels:
    ic-ops.com/phase: init

    event.toolkit.fluxcd.io/app: topic-service
    event.toolkit.fluxcd.io/phase: init

spec:
  dependsOn:
    - name: topic-service-bootstrap # Explicitly setting the depenencies

  timeout: 15m
  wait: true # wait for bootstrap to complete before applying

---

  dependsOn:

  interval: 1h
  timeout: 15m
  wait: true # waiting for init job to finish
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: OCIRepository
    name: topic-service-services

content.text: All seven `apps/topic-service` directories exist but are empty. Right, here's a tidy little script. I'll write it and run it.

input.content:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
SRC="$ROOT/topic-service"
FILES=(flux-kustomization.yaml oci-repo-bootstrap.yaml kustomization.yaml oci-repo-init.yaml oci-repo-services.yaml)
SEGMENTS=(apne1-2 apse2-2 euc1-2 euw1-2 euw2-2 use1-2 usw2-2)

for seg in "${SEGMENTS[@]}"; do
  dest="$ROOT/eks-saas-prod-$seg/apps/topic-service"
  mkdir -p "$dest"
  for f in "${FILES[@]}"; do
    sed "s/eks-saas-prod-SEGMENT/eks-saas-prod-$seg/g" "$SRC/$f" > "$dest/$f"
  done
  echo "wrote $dest"
done
